path: Early replay: raw h1(t)→L2..4 current update from recipient h_l(t−1)→original recipient suffix at absolute t+1; full frozen eval model, no cache/detach on differentiable path
state: raw unnormalized recurrent L1 h_n after right-neighbor value token; 256 coordinates, float32 primary
metric: raw Euclidean L2; actual cached FP32 edit displacement kept separate from ideal projection
geometry: v = (ridge_coef / saved_scaler_scale) / norm(ridge_coef/saved_scaler_scale), same raw weight as saved edit_weight; ideal projection=(d·v)v; report (d·v)^2/||d||^2 and actual cached delta, their difference, no standardized-space mixing
behavior: m=z[c+s]−z[c]; c=recipient true original count, s=saved local sign, including count-matched donors regardless donor final count
gradient: autograd at baseline raw recipient h1(t), model parameters require_grad=False; gradient of sum(m) gives per-row gradient because batch rows independent
undefined: Norm≤1e−12 makes normalized vectors/angle or donor-energy denominator undefined. Preserve NaN in NPZ and explicit empty/defined columns in CSV; no zero filling.
random: Eight original cached FP32 random displacements, no draws. Report actual g·delta_q and equal-norm derivative ||delta_local||g·(delta_q/||delta_q||), actual norm and cosine; no new intervention rescoring.
actual_change: Reuse saved early local/random and early unedited logits; cross-check differentiable no-grad FP32 baseline and local-edit logits against all original vocab logits before gradient use. Actual delta_m and linear gdot compared without asserting linearity.

finite_difference.subset: For each unit/task n=10,20,30 i=6, first saved pair in each(group,sign), all120cases; no outcome selection
directions: normalized first original random displacement seed1026
finite_difference.method: symmetric FP64 perturbation on FP64 copy of exact checkpoint parameters, same early graph, analytical gradient in FP64; derivative wiring only, not primary result

aggregation: Within unit/task/group/sign: within-center case mean, equal registered centers within length, fixed1/21 n10..30. Record finite/undefined counts; any undefined center makes fixed registered aggregate undefined (do not reweight). Allpair rows and length/center support retained. Fourunit mean/sampleSD/minmax with raw unit values; no casewise inferential independence.
output: NPZ per original cell with raw g,d,delta and random deltas; pair CSV with projection, norms, angle, gdot, actual m change, cached baseline/edited counts and support; unit/length +fourunit summaries, finite-difference and guard receipts.
